name: Real Analysis
description:
Review: Elementary set theory, countable and uncountable sets, the real number system and its order completeness. 
Metric spaces, open sets and closed sets, limit and continuity, separability and homeomorphism.
Complete metric space, contraction mappings, Baire category theorem, and totally bounded sets.
Connected metric spaces, compact metric spaces, compactness and continuous spaces, characterisation of compactness, Arzela-Ascoli theorem.
Sequence of functions, uniform convergence, Dini's theorem, Weierstrass approximation theorem 
Directional derivative, total derivative, mean-value theorem, higher-order derivatives, inverse function theorem and implicit function theorem.
